描述_EN: on the reverse there is a the underside of a lotus leaf with a butterfly. the bottle is a round flattened flask form without a stopper. the foot is in the form of a lotus pod and the base is integrated into the design of the bottle. the neck of the bottle is in the form of a thick stem. it is made of porcelain, moulded in relief and painted in pink, green, blue, yellow and black with gilding. on one shoulder are slender stems bound by ribbons which stream accross both sides of the bottle. the decoration depicts the underside of a lotus flower, with a butterfly.
描述_ZN: 背面有荷叶和蝴蝶的背面。 该瓶是一个圆形的扁平瓶形，没有塞子。 脚是莲花荚的形式，底座与瓶子的设计融为一体。 瓶子的颈部是粗茎的形式。 它是由瓷器制成的，模制的浮雕，涂有粉色、绿色、蓝色、黄色和黑色的鎏金。 在一个肩膀上有细长的茎，用丝带捆绑，穿过瓶子的两边。 装饰描绘了一朵莲花的底部，有一只蝴蝶。
